reasoning: While both plans aim to improve trail running speed, Plan A is better suited for achieving that goal. Plan B focuses almost exclusively on easy running and a single long run, which is more appropriate for building base endurance but less effective for improving speed. The inclusion of aerobic runs in Plan A, alongside the tempo session, provides a more balanced approach to training, addressing both endurance and speed.
